findings.layer: S3/Content (42:15263), S3/Type (42:15321), S3/Cream circle (42:15421), S3/Terracotta circle (42:15423)
findings.problem: The r1 'not dead' drift breaks the S3 grid. S3/Content scales 1 → 1.045 about the frame centre and S3/Type adds −40. The type column drifts from x 62–66 (f210) to x 47–51 (f274), about 17 px outside the 64 margin, and the arch goes to x 46. 'AUTUMN 2026' climbs from 59 px to 12 px below the 'Moku' bug (measured at f274: kicker y 360–382, bug 301–348). At the end of the scene's 2.8 s hold the kicker reads as part of the logo line, and the header hierarchy collapses.
findings.fix: Pivot the drift on the column's top-left (64,416) instead of the frame centre. S3/Content TRANSLATION_XY: add a last key, giving @0 -78,110 · @6 -78,110 L · @6.7 0,0 OUT · @9.6 21.4,24.5 L. The value is 0.045 × (476,544); SCALE_XY stays as it is, so both are LINEAR over 6.7–9.6. S3/Type TRANSLATION_Y: change the last key from @9.6 -40 to @9.6 -10. Move the rest positions of S3/Cream circle and S3/Terracotta circle by +18,+21 (x -1176 → -1158, y -262 → -241), so the bloom still seeds on the same spot of the bowl wall. Result: the left edge stays on x 64, the kicker stays at least 57 px below the bug, the arch bottom ends at about 1544 (inside 1580), and the right edge of 'Dinner Plates' ends at about 1000.

findings.layer: S2/Band window (42:15364), S2/Push (42:15365), S2/Plate clay (42:15376), S2/Plate terracotta (42:15377)
findings.problem: The band's top edge at y 540 cuts the 230 px 'Ash Vase' 31 px below its x-height (measured lowercase 509–601, baseline 600). Every lowercase letter carries a thin cream sliver on top. The lower two-thirds of 'ase' sit on the band grey (189,184,179), where terracotta measures 2.8:1, below the 3:1 floor for large text. On the product hero, held 1.5 s, the overlap reads as misregistration, not as a deliberate overlap.
findings.fix: Sit the baseline on the band edge: move the band top to y 600 (+60) and keep the photo screen-locked. S2/Band window: rest y 540 → 600; HEIGHT key @4.1 1040 → 980; TRANSLATION_XY @0 and @3.6 336,592 → 336,532 (the dot stays centred on 384,1180). S2/Push: rest y 0 → -60; TRANSLATION_XY @0 and @3.6 -336,-592 → -336,-532, so the vase, dimension line, ticks and '32 cm' do not move on screen. S2/Plate clay and S2/Plate terracotta: height 1040 → 980, rest y -1040 → -980; TRANSLATION_Y start value 1040 → 980 on both keys (@0 and @3.8 for clay, @0 and @3.7333 for terracotta). The whole headline then sits on cream (terracotta 5.2:1), and the vase rim keeps about 185 px of wall above it.

findings.problem: Past list items dim to opacity 0.35. Measured at f260 on linen: the names are 2.16:1 and the prices 1.83:1, which is illegible for 28–32 px Inter on a phone. 'Dinner Plates / $110 · set of 4' is readable at full contrast for only about 0.5 s (7.6–8.13): five words, about 0.1 s per word against the brief's 0.3 s floor. 'Kiln Mug / $32' gets 0.6 s. Two of the three collection prices never get a fair read.
findings.fix: Keep the timing and change the dim value from 0.35 to 0.6. S3/Name 1 OPACITY last key → @7.4 0.6 SOFT. S3/Price 1 → @7.4333 0.6 SOFT. S3/Name 2 → @8.3 0.6 SOFT. S3/Price 2 → @8.3333 0.6 SOFT. Names land at about 4:1 and prices at about 3.1:1. The active item (15:1) and the terracotta pointer still clearly lead, and the whole list stays readable until the bloom at 9.2.

findings.problem: 'first order.', and then 'order.' alone, are still inside S5/Field while it shrinks to pill proportions (about 300 px tall at f339). For 3–4 frames, just before 'Shop the collection' lands, the field reads as a terracotta button labelled 'order.'.
findings.fix: Start the exits earlier, staggered one frame behind 'off' (10.9333). S5/your TRANSLATION_Y: @10.9333 0 L · @11.1333 116 IN (was 11.0 / 11.2). S5/first: @10.9667 0 L · @11.1667 116 IN (was 11.0667 / 11.2667). S5/order.: @11.0 0 L · @11.2 116 IN (was 11.1333 / 11.3333). Every word is gone by f336, while the field is still about 1000 px tall. findings.problem: At full growth the ripple ring spans y 1011–1308 (measured at f408, opacity about 0.35). It cuts straight through 'moku.store' (1277–1304) and comes within 7 px of the offer row's descenders (1004). A terracotta line through the URL muddies the one line a viewer may need to type.
findings.fix: Contain the ripple between the offer row and the URL. Change these S5/Ripple keys @13.9: WIDTH 880 → 800, HEIGHT 300 → 200, TRANSLATION_XY -120,-90 → -80,-40, CORNER_RADIUS 150 → 100. Keep the birth at 692×130, STROKE_WEIGHT 8 → 1.5 and the FADE opacity. The ring ends at x 140–940, y 1060–1260: 56 px below the offer row and about 19 px above the drifting URL (top at about 1279 by 13.9).

findings.layer: S1/By hand (frame, rest 64,404); interacts with S1/Ring (42:15863)
findings.problem: The descender of 'By' (bottom y 561) hangs 23 px above the wheel ring (ring top y 584 at f91). At the ring's 1.02 overshoot (2.8 s) the gap is 9 px, right where the ring's trim starts at 12 o'clock. Meanwhile 'By hand.' has 81 px of air above it to the bug, so the line looks pressed onto the ring.
findings.fix: Move S1/By hand rest y 404 → 384 (−20). The glyphs land at y 409–541: 61 px below the bug baseline, 39 px above the ring at rest and 29 px at the overshoot. No keyframe change is needed; S1/By and S1/hand. translate inside their masks.

findings.layer: S4/Bowl arc (frame at 358,690, 364×48) / S4/Bowl arc path (42:15109)
findings.problem: The shallow upturned terracotta arc centred under the 'Moku' wordmark (y 687–733) reads as a smile, close to the Amazon swoosh, not as a bowl. It sits in the logo lockup on the frame held longest (2.4 s).
findings.fix: Make it a rule. Re-import SVG E1 as <svg width='200' height='4' viewBox='0 0 200 4'><path d='M2 2H198' stroke='#a4532f' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/></svg>. Place the wrapper as S4/Bowl arc at (440,708) and name the vector S4/Bowl arc path. Re-apply the same tracks unchanged: OPACITY @0 0 · @11.6083 0 L · @11.6283 1 L; PATH_TRIM_START @0 0.5 · @11.6 0.5 L · @12 0 DRAW; PATH_TRIM_END @0 0.5 · @11.6 0.5 L · @12 1 DRAW. It still draws centre-out on the beat, with 48 px clear above and 53 px clear below. If the ceramic reference must stay, use a true bowl section with a flat foot (about 220 × 70) instead, and move S4/Tagline down 24.
